title: Preview line
description: One affected row of a held write, as basalt_meta.preview_lines writes it, in the text rules of CONTRACT.md, Stores, Text rules. Lines are ordered bytewise (COLLATE "C"). See CONTRACT.md, Approvals.

shape.description: The kind of data the values describe (CONTRACT.md, Stores, Shapes). RECORD: fields and values. OBJECT is reserved: a page refuses to offer signing for it, and for a shape it does not know.

kind.description: The store's kind (CONTRACT.md, Stores). A page uses it as a label only.

verb.description: The store's own word for the operation (in Postgres the command: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).

key.description: The identity fields of the old row (the primary key in Postgres); null for INSERT.

old.description: Full old row; null for INSERT.

set.description: New values of the assigned fields; null for DELETE and cascaded rows.

resource.description: What the row belongs to, in the store's form: schema.table in Postgres. Untrusted plain text on a page.

rowHash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of [key, old, set] written by the text rules (in Postgres jsonb_build_array(key, old, set)::text).

redacted.description: The agent role cannot read this row (in Postgres, cannot SELECT its table), so key and values are hidden.
